title: Goodnight Stories | A New Tortoise and Hare
subtitle: The things you never knew
body:
The little tortoise had liked the rabbit for a long time. But whenever the rabbit ran merrily past with her friends, she would already be out of sight before the tortoise could say the hello she had spent so long preparing. After thinking for a long time, the little tortoise decided to confess her feelings: “Hey! I hear you run very fast. How about a bet? I want to race you!” “Huh? What do you want to bet?” The rabbit was curious. “B-b-bet that if you lose, you have to be my girlfriend for a day!” The little tortoise rushed through the sentence and quickly lowered her head. “Huh? Oh! Sure! No problem!” The rabbit was a little bewildered. But when she saw the little tortoise’s flushed face as she quickly lowered her head, she agreed to the bet without thinking. She did not even ask what would happen if the little tortoise lost.
The day of the race soon arrived. The little tortoise had practiced desperately for a month, but she still had little confidence. Sure enough, the starting gun sounded, and the rabbit vanished from sight. The little tortoise felt a little bitter. So she really was a joke, after all. Even thinking this, she still crawled toward the finish as fast as she could. An hour passed, then another. Suddenly a figure came into view. The rabbit had actually fallen asleep against a tree! Surprised, the little tortoise ran up to her. “Bunny, didn’t you say we were going to race for our bet?” The rabbit rolled over. “Shh, I’m taking a nap. Run if you want to.” Secretly delighted, the little tortoise quietly quickened her pace again. As the tortoise’s footsteps faded, no one saw the sly little smile at the corner of the rabbit’s mouth.
We all know what happened afterward: in the race between the tortoise and the hare, the clumsy little tortoise actually beat the rabbit. What we do not know is that the rabbit readily agreed to be the tortoise’s girlfriend for a day. What we know even less is that one day before bed, the little tortoise held the rabbit and asked curiously, “If I’d lost the bet that day, would we never have been together?” The rabbit kissed the little tortoise’s forehead fondly. “Silly. If you’d lost, your punishment would have been to be my girlfriend!”
